structured_output.summary: The getter follows the spec steps in order. It throws a TypeError for a non-object. It returns "(?:)" for %RegExp.prototype%, using same_value. It throws a TypeError for other objects without RegExp data. Otherwise it returns the escaped source. The escaping is general. It escapes unescaped `/` and the line terminators LF, CR, U+2028 and U+2029. It keeps existing `\x` pairs, so it never double-escapes `\/`. It turns a backslash followed by a line terminator into the matching escape, which matches the same character. An empty pattern gives "(?:)". Flags are unused, and the code comments give a valid reason: the escapes produced are valid in every pattern mode. The gate report shows all 24 target runs passing with no regressions, and the diff touches only the one in-scope file.
